title: Amee skin manifest
description: The manifest.json Amee itself reads. This file is the JS-side mirror of `SkinManifest` and `validate_manifest` in the Amee repo's src-tauri/src/skin.rs — the numeric bounds below are the single source of truth for tools/validate.mjs, so the two never drift by hand. Cross-relational rules that JSON Schema can't express (min <= base <= max, content_height needing a pinned height range, the graceful_shutdown pairing) live in tools/lib.mjs's validateManifest and are commented there against the same Rust function.

id.description: Package id. Must equal the registry directory name.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in Amee's Skins tab and in the store.

version.description: Semver. Amee treats this as free text, but the store requires a real semver so it can order releases.

entry.description: Plain filename of the ES module exporting mount(container, amee). No path separators, no `..`. Defaults to main.js.

content_height.description: Height of the actually-painted band; the difference from `height` is reserved blank space split evenly above and below. Must be <= height.
